short_zones.label: Short on rejection from upper-liquidity resistance

no_trade_conditions: Do not enter before a confirmed rejection from 84800-85000.
Do not chase a short after the downside liquidity zones have already been swept.
Stand aside if price breaks and holds above 88000 or confirms an unfinished bullish fifth wave.
notes: Primary thesis is a corrective wave 2 after a completed five-wave advance. A tactical short is favored only after rejection near 84800-85000; the main downside magnets are 82600-82700, 79000-80000, and 74000-75000. The lower-liquidity long zone is secondary and requires structural confirmation.
